sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: REVERSAL: The complete dependency contract and semantic obligation explicitly identify openWaterServiceSpeed as the >=18-knot comparison operand; retain designOperationSpeedInIce as the declared input, but add the canonical ship-owned openWaterServiceSpeed quantity and use its knot numeric value for the threshold. The conditional branches still reduce the forefoot and upper-bow obligations to unqualified boolean flags and omit the required five-main-frame-spacing and upper-limit-to-2 m / at-least-0.2 L aft-of-forward-perpendicular extents; locate canonical owner-correct extent/relationship terms and constrain them in the IA Super and IA-plus-speed branches.
